# ddd-understand: Align with Business Model and Goals

## Purpose
Align technical decisions with the organization's business model, user needs, and strategic goals (short, medium, and long-term).

## Why It Matters
- Every architectural decision has business and user consequences
- Misaligned architecture can prevent achieving business goals
- Optimal business impact requires alignment with business strategy
- User needs drive software value

## Key Activities

### Business Model Alignment
- Map out the organization's business model
- Understand value propositions
- Identify key partners, activities, and resources
- Understand revenue streams and cost structure
- Connect technical work to business outcomes

### User Needs Understanding
- Map user journeys and stories
- Identify user pain points and goals
- Understand current and potential future needs
- Prioritize user experience considerations

### Strategic Goal Clarification
- Define short-term objectives (3-6 months)
- Identify medium-term targets (6-18 months)
- Articulate long-term vision (18+ months)
- Understand how technical decisions support each timeframe

## Recommended Tools

### Business Model Canvas
- **Purpose**: Visualize and understand the business model
- **When**: Start of projects, major initiatives, strategic reviews
- **Output**: Shared understanding of how the business creates value
- **Link**: https://www.strategyzer.com/canvas/business-model-canvas

### Impact Mapping
- **Purpose**: Connect features to business goals via user behaviors
- **When**: Planning features, prioritizing work
- **Output**: Clear path from goals to deliverables
- **Link**: https://www.impactmapping.org/

### User Story Mapping
- **Purpose**: Visualize user journey and identify value slices
- **When**: Planning releases, understanding user workflow
- **Output**: Prioritized backlog aligned with user needs
- **Link**: https://www.jpattonassociates.com/user-story-mapping/

### Product Strategy Canvas
- **Purpose**: Define product strategy and vision
- **When**: Product planning, strategic pivots
- **Output**: Clear product strategy
- **Link**: https://melissaperri.com/blog/2016/07/14/what-is-good-product-strategy

### Wardley Mapping
- **Purpose**: Understand evolution and positioning in value chain
- **When**: Strategic planning, build vs buy decisions
- **Output**: Visual map of competitive landscape and evolution
- **Link**: https://learnwardleymapping.com/

## Who to Involve
- Software designers, builders, testers
- Domain knowledge holders
- Product and business strategy experts
- Real end users (not just their representatives)

## Key Questions to Answer
1. What business outcomes are we trying to achieve?
2. How do we create value for our users and customers?
3. What are our competitive advantages?
4. What are the key business constraints?
5. How will we measure success?
6. What user problems are we solving?
7. How does this work support short, medium, and long-term goals?

## Success Criteria
- Team can articulate business goals in their own words
- Technical decisions reference business impact
- User needs are documented and prioritized
- Strategic alignment is explicit in planning
- Trade-offs are evaluated against business objectives

## Common Pitfalls
- Skipping this step to "get to coding faster"
- Only involving technical people
- Working from assumptions instead of validated understanding
- Treating this as one-time activity instead of ongoing alignment
- Focusing only on technical requirements without business context

## Integration with Other Steps
- **Feeds into Discover**: Business context guides domain exploration
- **Feeds into Strategize**: Strategic goals inform core domain identification
- **Feeds into Organise**: Business model influences team structure
- **Continuous**: Revisit as business goals evolve

## AI Agent Prompts

When asking AI to help with this step, use prompts like:
- "Help me create a Business Model Canvas for [domain]"
- "What strategic questions should we ask stakeholders about [business area]?"
- "How can we align our architecture to support [business goal]?"
- "Create an impact map connecting [feature] to [business outcome]"
- "What user research questions would reveal needs for [domain]?"

## Example Outputs
- Completed Business Model Canvas
- User story map with value slices
- Impact map linking goals to deliverables
- Strategic alignment document
- User research findings summary
